name: B10-0430/2025 (PfE) – Humanitarian and security situation in Haiti, in particular the rising power of criminal gangs and the recent massacre in Cabaret
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the humanitarian and security situation in Haiti, in particular the rising power of criminal gangs and the recent massacre in Cabaret
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns the gang violence in Haiti, including the September 2025 massacre in Cabaret, and deplores attacks on aid workers. It demands that gangs stop their violence immediately. It welcomes the United Nations Security Council's decision to send a new international force to crack down on gangs. It also condemns gangs' use of sexual violence and their recruitment of children, and calls for Haiti's public institutions to be restored.

- The Parliament takes a position; it does not change any law.
- The condemnation targets Haiti's gangs and those affected by their violence.
- The new United Nations-authorized security force is expected to be deployed.
